## Signed receipts, and a verifier anyone can run {#receipts}

<span class="kicker">The proof · released in tfd 0.10.0</span>

<div class="cards">
<div class="card"><strong>What tfd signs</strong>
<ul>
<li>A receipt for every payment and refund, signed with the business's Ed25519 key, for the payer to keep.</li>
<li>Made from the event alone, so the books can make it again, byte for byte. An edit to the books shows.</li>
<li>A refund is a new receipt naming the payment it reverses. Nothing is edited.</li>
<li>No name or email inside.</li>
</ul></div>
<div class="card card--green"><strong>Who can check it</strong>
<ul>
<li>Anyone who holds a receipt: a family, a CPA, an auditor.</li>
<li>In a browser, with the open verifier <code>tfd-verify</code>. Nothing leaves the page.</li>
<li>Or at a terminal: <code>tfd verify receipt</code> and <code>tfd verify seals</code>.</li>
<li>The format, spec and verifier are Apache-2.0; the test vectors are public domain (CC0).</li>
</ul></div>
<div class="card card--ink"><strong>What it catches</strong>
<ul>
<li>An edit in a sealed month: the seal stops matching.</li>
<li>A deleted payment: the seal names every event.</li>
<li>A forged or inflated receipt: the signature fails.</li>
<li><span class="tag tag--next">Next</span> An edit before the month is sealed: a hash chain over every event.</li>
</ul></div>
</div>

<p class="fine">Released 7 November 2026. No school issues these receipts yet, and no state program has accepted them; the first school pilot is next. The tfd engine is source-available (FSL-1.1-ALv2) and free to self-host; every release becomes Apache-2.0 two years after it ships.</p>

::: {.notes}
Sources: `docs/business/business-plan.md` §1 and §3 (signed receipts and sealed months "Released in tfd 0.10.0 (milestone 1, justbry/atm #123 and #137). Not yet issued by any school"; audited 2026-11-07); `packages/atm/README.md`, "Receipts and seals (new in 0.10.0)" (Ed25519 receipt per `payment.succeeded` and `payment.refunded`, a pure function of its event; no name or email; the CLI commands); `packages/atm/ROADMAP.md`, "Signed receipts and sealed months (milestone 1)" ("Not live anywhere yet: buzz-school doesn't issue receipts or seal months"). `docs/business/website-open-questions.md` 4.2: claim schools issue receipts only once a design-partner school does. No source says any state program accepts them; `docs/business/market-research.md` §4 and §5 say each program's receipt rules still need checking.

Verifier: `packages/verify/README.md` (`tfd-verify`: tfd's receipt and seal checks for browsers and other WebCrypto runtimes, "nothing leaves the page"; Apache-2.0; not published to npm). Licenses: AGENTS.md, "Licensing" (format, spec, verifier Apache-2.0; vectors CC0-1.0; engine FSL-1.1-ALv2 from 0.10.0, the first FSL release; releases up to 0.9.0 stay Apache-2.0; two-year conversion kept by the owner on 2026-11-07). Wording rule: say source-available or free to self-host for tfd, never the OSI label.

What catches what: `apps/trifold-site/src/content/how-it-works.md`, "What catches what" (first rows Today; edit before sealing is Next). Known limits: ROADMAP milestone 1, "Known limits" (open month not sealed until close; a receipt does not prove Stripe moved the money).

A self-hosted tfd issues self-signed receipts: "verifiable with the open verifier", never "Witnessed by Trifold" (TRADEMARKS.md).
:::
